quote.text: I keep getting charged for subscriptions I forgot about

promise.text: How to find all your paid subscriptions

art.why: the carousel's topic: the moment and its guide name "subscription"

lines.text: Search statements, billing platforms and receipts to trace recurring charges, identify who owns each plan, and catch annual renewals a short review misses.

eyebrow.text: Run a search with a visible boundary

items.text: Review roughly twelve months where available.
Check Apple subscriptions under each relevant Apple Account.
Check Google Play subscriptions under the Google Account that made the purchase.
Record the service, billing owner, actual amount and cycle, next known charge, and evidence.

line.text: Subscriptions are their own area, with amounts and renewal dates, and a missing renewal date shows up in Attention rather than being quietly ignored.
